reviews.text: Zack was amazing about talking on the products they sell and his wonderful dogs at home. He was easy to relate with on pet topics. He clearly loves his job!
Zach was amazing! It’s obvious he loves what he does.
wide variety of good quality

Steve and Kelly at the store at Hayden and Thompson peak are so awesome.   The products are excellent and they always make sure my favorites are well stocked and they are excellent at placing special orders when I need extra.    10 stars for products and 10+ for service.
Bryan was so helpful and informative about the different dog foods! Had to give that man a shoutout.
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Tricia! We truly appreciate your support and are so glad you had a great experience with us. We look forward to welcoming you back to My Pet Market again soon!

Absolutely the worst of the worst of the worst of the shops for pets in this town. Owners, you need to make changes with your employee. He should be fired on the spot.
Yesterday I stopped by around 8:40pm. Jorge, the cashier, didn’t say hello. Was busy with paperwork. I stopped by, say hi, he doesn’t lift his head from his papers and ask me, WITH NO ONE ELSE IN THE STORE,  to wait. Not “please give me a minute I am with you right away” with a smile. No no. Just “wait”.

Then I asked for two cookies, his answer, still without looking at me, is “serve yourself”. I asked for a paper bag, I get one. Then I need another paper bag because I am offering treats  to 2 different dogs: no answer. I have to ask a second time. Still not looking at me.

Then I go to the cashier. Jorge still doesn’t look at me, doesn’t talk to me and ignores me. I had to wait that he comes to the cashier to pay. Remember: there is no one else in the shop! I even had to ask TWICE for a plastic bag to carry my purchase. TWICE. Not a good bye, never looked at me… you know that feeling when someone is making your feeel you are not welcome? That’s Jorge.

I’ll never come back to this shop and I encourage anyone who read that review  to go wants to buy treats to their dogs to cross the street and go to PetMart next to Fry’s. Where people are polite, welcoming and nice. J up
Great selection pet food. They will price match. You just have to pull it up on your phone and show them.
Rick was so helpful today with my new pup, Sir Theodore. His suggestions help feed my picky eater. Thank you.
Honestly, a little bit disappointed I bought a harness for my dog there that fell apart in one use I mean the treats and food selections great but super disappointed about purchase   I made
Cute market located in biltmore.
Amazing service! Thanks a bunch!
Super friendly and has great brands, however very limited selection if you are looking for something specific.
Love it there but bit pricey thou got my dog favorite food Earthborn chicken so but pricey otherwise friendly faces

Thanks for the five stars Andi! We're so glad you had such a good experience in the store

The ladies on staff the day I was in were very helpful in finding the products I needed for my sweet rescue named Candy, she had five teeth removed the week before & Pet Market staff was very kind & empathetic, in fact I need to return for the chews they found for my girl!
Great customer service and fantastic pet friendly store with natural food options
Fantastic Selection, Frozen RAW petfood AMAZING Experience by 🔴➡️ALEXANDRIA with Great Customer service and 🔴➡️ JAXON super knowledgeable …
GREAT SELECTION GREAT CUSTUMER SERVICE. BY ALEXANDRIA

I am visiting family in California and was frantically calling stores to find the dog food I need. Alexandria was so very patient and helpful when we stopped by. She even set aside our food for us so we could get back on the road and keep on schedule. Thanks for stocking our pups food and thank you for having a great staff!

This is my go to pet store and I always recommend it to others! All of the staff are always so kind and attentive. Alexandria, Jonathan, Jaxon, Rick, and Ronald are normally the workers I see and since I’m in at least once a week, they’ve gotten to know exactly what I’m looking for. They also make some great suggestions for different alternatives of food or treats that my cats may like.

This review is for the incredible employees at pet market that has always helped me and gone above and beyond every time I come through for my cat, Habibi.  I just want to publicly think Rick, Ronnie, Jaxon, Alexandria, and Jonathan. I appreciate all the work you guys do and helping me understand my cat better and offering me the best products available.

Knowledgeable and friendly staff- they are animal lovers themselves, not just people who happen to work at a pet food store. Alexandra helped me choose a low phosphorus food for kidney health. Ducky gave me some samples to help with digestive health. Ronnie is always friendly and alerted me to a coupon I didn't know was available.  Yes, they will price match as well and the selection of one of a kind foods is unmatched.  Highly recommended 👌
Alexandria is always upbeat & helpful. Goes above and beyond with her customer service.
This is my favorite pet market! They are always so helpful and knowledgeable. They are so sweet to our new little guy Thanks Alexandria, Megan and Zach <3

I went into the store and was having trouble finding a certain brand of pet food that my cats would like and Ducky was extremely helpful and knowledgeable on every available product in the store. It made my decision so much easier and am extremely impressed with the details I was provided with! 5 stars
Great selection of products. Very friendly and helpful employee named Ducky assisted me. I will definitely recommend this store to my freinds and family

Had an amazing experience at the Pet Market today looking for some new wet food for our two cats. Ducky quickly came over to check on us and ended up helping us pick out some amazing options for our kitties to try and even gave us some samples of dry food! She was so knowledgeable, friendly and helpful.

They also price match which is amazing to be able to support a local business and get a good deal.

I highly recommended asking for Ducky whenever you stop in!
I was looking for the right cat food for my kitty and Ducky was amazing helping me find the right options. I will always come back for the great customer service.

I was very happy to run into the employee whose nametag was "Ducky." She was friendly and good humored, and very helpful.  I was in and out in a flash, sooner than I expected, and she seems to genuinely love animals. Always great to see someone working where they belong. ^_^
I'll be back everyone was nice ducky helped me out and she was helpful and all smiles

Great experience, helpful staff! Love the selection. Bought a couple sweaters each for our pups and some other odds and ends. Pricing is a bit more "boutique" prices, but a small difference for one stop shopping!
Thanks for the five stars Daisy! We're so glad you had such a good experience in the store!

I went for the first time in many years to the pets market on Hayden and Thompson Peak in Scottsdale, as. It was a great experience the new manager Stephen gave me and my new puppy undivided attention. He was knowledgeable and friendly and it was just a great experience. I ended up buying a bunch of fun treats and brand new dog beds. I’ll definitely be a regular customer thanks to him.
